answer.summary: A bounded investigation is required to identify minimal, observable proxy indicators of contextual coherence in agent memory mechanisms without feature extraction or explicit state tracking.
answer.content: This task focuses on retrieving and analyzing Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1 for explicit descriptions of memory binding mechanisms that integrate temporal context without relying on feature vectors or extraction. If such mechanisms are present, define the smallest set of observable, non-feature-based indicators that could signal contextual coherence across repeated queries under stable input conditions. The analysis must be strictly grounded in direct source content and avoid speculative or implementation-based inferences.
